notes.title: Some impracticable problems (No access to the stage.)
notes.notes:
Some impracticable problems (No access to the stage.)

[EPIDO] has the ability to check if there is a Cover.png file inside the game folder.

Due to these features, it is not possible to run normally by some conservative anti-virus programs. ːsteamsadː

Please make [EPIDO] an exception in the anti-virus program.

( or Disable deep guard in your antivirus program )

Thank you.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34941711/a9a71baeaf05b6d2708f2c6abbe46b5ff947506d.jpg[/img]

※ Additional stages (DLC) are still being developed.
